verdict: Yes. Manetain from Kochi pitched curly hair care products on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Many Indians have wavy or curly hair, and most products aren't made for it, so a focused brand has loyal buyers.
angle: The curly-hair community online is active and loyal. Curl creams, gels and sulphate-free shampoos sell well. Education on routines and before-and-after content drive sales.
